corrections.reason: Joining with previous page end 'ተውሳ ልብስ' (having borrowed clothes). Visually the 6th-order 'ስ' has its top-left notch clearly visible.
Canonical Ge'ez Marian salutation 'ሰላም ለኪ ኦ እምሄውቱ ለፀሐየ ጽድቅ' (Peace be to thee, O grandmother of the Sun of Righteousness). Visually the character is 'ሄ' (5th order of ሀ), not 'ኒ'.
Joining with next line 'አርፏል' (he rested/died). Visually the last character on L25 is 1st-order 'አ', not 'ኦ'.
Amharic 'ከብት' (cattle/livestock). Visually the first character is 1st-order 'ከ', not 6th-order 'ክ'.
